lines.noah: Shem, see the bow? It is the Lord's promise. The Lord kept us through the water. Never forget it, son. Every time it rains, look for the bow in the cloud.
lines.shem: Father says the Lord spoke to him. I believe him. Seven pairs of the clean animals, father. I'll count them with you. Blessed be the Lord, who kept us alive.
